prompts.agromaf:
Use case: identity-preserve / compositing.
Asset type: edited professional portrait for Arturo Vela's work contact card.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the original portrait. Input image 2 is the original full-color company logo. Input image 3 is the official white-wordmark variant, to insert into the background.
Primary request: create one company-branded version of the original photo. Preserve this exact person's identity, facial proportions, expression, hairstyle, glasses, natural skin texture and skin tone, navy suit, white shirt and tie. Edit the background and add the provided company logo; do not beautify, redraw, recolor, or replace his face.
Composition: vertical 3:4 portrait, same frontal camera angle and business pose. Keep the full hair, face, chin, neck and shoulders comfortably visible. Allow a little extra clean headroom for the logo above his head, separated from his hair; no logo overlaps the person. Insert the full official logo once in the upper background, centered in a reserved clean band, about 60% of image width, entirely above the hair. Keep the logo, face and chin within the upper 75% of the image so a top-aligned square mobile crop preserves them. Retain the torso in the lower portion.
Style: photorealistic professional photography, restrained corporate background, matte surfaces, soft natural studio light. Face lighting stays neutral and realistic. No glow, neon, badges, new props, extra people, invented labels or watermarks. Remove the original small sparkle at bottom right. Preserve the supplied logo's geometry, wordmark typography and color elements exactly; use its white text variant for dark-background contrast. This is a photograph, not a website mockup or a presentation slide.
Company: Cía. Agromaf. Background: calm dark forest-green corporate backdrop with restrained green accents corresponding to #63A437, retaining strong contrast with the white logo. The supplied logo's multicolor agricultural gear mark stays unchanged. Exact logo text: "AGROMAF" and "TECNOLOGÍA AL SERVICIO DEL AGRICULTOR". No other text.
